name: Morning Wood
source:
You playing as a desperate horny milf mom willing to get pregnant at any means necessary!
When a STRANGE COMET shows up, strange things start to happen to milf mom because of his radiation!
And she and her son being alone home, things can go pretty easy out of control...

[From Itch.io]
translation:
你扮演一位欲火焚身、急不可耐的辣妈，为了怀孕什么都肯做！
一颗诡异彗星出现后，受它的辐射影响，辣妈身上开始发生种种怪事！
而家里只有她和儿子，事情一个不留神就可能失控…
